provenance.normalization_method: Shared schema, cross-source editorial categories, normalized style/color fields, and derived search terms. Original icon IDs, ordering, gallery assignments, and source metadata are preserved.

original_catalog_metadata.title: Healthcare-only SVG icon inventory
original_catalog_metadata.classification_method: Semantic editorial classification from the supplied identifiers, display names, tags, and source context, with ambiguous artwork visually inspected. All review and brand entries were assigned to one of two groups.

definitions.general: Reusable UI, graphics and image-editing tools, charts, basic anatomy used as everyday metaphors, accessibility, family/person symbols, nutrition, ordinary hygiene, safety gear, and general objects.
definitions.healthcare: Clinical anatomy and biology, diseases and symptoms, diagnostics, medicines, treatments, clinical equipment, healthcare professionals and facilities, medical records and informatics, reproductive care, and disease-specific public-health workflows.

boundary_notes: Simple brains used for thinking/AI, ears for hearing, eyes for visibility, ordinary body silhouettes, skulls for danger, basic pregnancy/parenting figures, and everyday hygiene objects are general-purpose. Detailed organ systems, symptoms, clinical measurements, and gestational-stage care concepts remain healthcare.

Generic microscopes, lab glassware, thermometers, mobility/accessibility symbols, and image-editing tools stay general. Disease tests, patient devices, DICOM/HL7 workflows, and radiology-study operations remain healthcare.

Masks, clinical gowns, and items explicitly marked with medical or infection-control symbols remain healthcare. Ordinary aprons, gloves, safety goggles, respirators, face shields, wipes, and unmarked hygiene supplies are general.
Five healthcare system/standard identities are included and explicitly flagged as is_brand_or_standard_identity. The Excel identity is general.
Original source-qualified identifiers, spelling, numbered designs, and existing variant consolidation are preserved. Similar icons across sources were not merged.
Each input icon appears in exactly one text list, in original input order. The icons array in this file contains only the healthcare group.
